guitar.evidence: Dio's guitarists (Vivian Campbell on Holy Diver/Last in Line era, later Craig Goldy) commonly used Jackson/Charvel-style superstrats typical of early-80s metal, but no single guitar is iconic enough for higher confidence.

tone.target: heavy mid-forward 80s metal crunch with tight sustain
tone.profile: heavy mid-forward 80s metal crunch with tight sustain
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a Boost and Distortion pedal into an aggressive UK 45/UK 30 style amp, paired with a robust 4x12 cabinet to achieve the necessary punch and sustain.
